title: 目標達成の後に・コード：ファイアー！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Summer camp is in full swing. Looking for praise, Mayano Top Gun throws herself into our various training methods.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bragging that she has become strong enough, she claims she can excite me even more than Narita Brian does with her running abilities.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In order to prove this, she decides to take on the Kikuka Sho, one of the Triple Crown tour races that Narita Brian herself raced in.
